lines.zh: 死谷的沙地上，我一小步一小步走
lines.en: On the dead valley's sand I take small steps

lines.zh: 六条腿在干土上，扬起一点灰
lines.en: Six legs on dry earth raise a little dust
The wind here is dry

lines.zh: 我跟在影子后面，躲太阳
lines.en: I walk behind shadows, out of the sun
Nothing grows in the dead valley

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，脚印很快就没了
lines.en: My prints vanish quickly behind me

lines.zh: 我身子小，走在石头缝里
lines.en: I am small, I walk between the stones
The rock pillars far off look like people
When I walk, the sand slides down
A glance up: the sky is all grey

lines.zh: 我走得不快，可我从不停
lines.en: Slow, and I never break stride

lines.zh: 骨头埋在沙里，我绕过去
lines.en: Bones lie in the sand, I go around them

lines.zh: 我沿着死谷的干河床走
lines.en: I walk along the dead valley's dry riverbed

lines.zh: 一块石头挡住我，我绕了很久
lines.en: A stone blocks me and I take a long way around
My shadow is short on the sand

lines.zh: 我用触角试探前面的沙
lines.en: I test the sand ahead with my antennae

lines.zh: 我趴在沙上，和沙一个颜色
lines.en: I lie on the sand, the same color as the sand
The dead valley is quiet, only wind
Even insects are scarce here

lines.zh: 我把身子埋进沙里一半
lines.en: I bury half my body in the sand

lines.zh: 我听见远处有石头滚落
lines.en: I hear stones fall in the distance

lines.zh: 我伸出一只脚，试试风向
lines.en: I put out one leg to test the wind
My shell is hot from the sun

lines.zh: 我一动不动，装成一块石头
lines.en: I stay still, posing as a stone
I will move when it cools
I look up, not one cloud

lines.zh: 死谷里活着的东西很少
lines.en: Very little lives in the dead valley

lines.zh: 你在死谷里，倒是很少见
lines.en: You in the dead valley, that is rare

lines.zh: 我抬起头，眼睛在沙里很亮
lines.en: I lift my head, my eyes bright against the sand
I am this small, you must crouch
Did you step on a bone
There is no water here, did you bring any

lines.zh: 我往后退，沙滑下去一点
lines.en: I step back and a little sand slides

lines.zh: 我不叫，这里叫也没人应
lines.en: I do not call out, nothing answers here
I see your shadow
The dead valley wind dries a body out
I shake myself and burrow into the sand

lines.zh: 你手上没有沙，你是从外面来的
lines.en: No sand on your hands, you came from outside
When I move, the sand sounds
I burrow halfway into the sand
A pit in my shell
My six legs thrash
The pain flattens me
I make a faint sound
Sand has gotten into the wound

lines.zh: 我退了很远，沙都被翻起来
lines.en: I backed far, churning the sand
A wound like this is trouble in the dead valley
Let it not fall on me again
What could there be to eat in the dead valley
I have not seen that before
I sniff it, it is dry
I bite it, too hard
I eat slowly, there is nothing else here
Leave it, I will come back

lines.zh: 我把它拉到沙里藏起来
lines.en: I drag it into the sand to hide it
The wind covers it with dust
This mouthful will last me two days
Do not watch me eat

lines.zh: 你蹲在沙上，东西举得很稳
lines.en: You crouch on the sand, holding it steady

lines.zh: 我绕着它走了半圈才敢咬
lines.en: I circled it half a turn before daring a bite

lines.zh: 我被撞得在沙上滑了一段
lines.en: The bump slid me across the sand

lines.zh: 我六条腿插进沙里，稳住了
lines.en: My six legs dug into the sand and held
You are so heavy the sand sinks

lines.zh: 我退了半步，壳上沾了沙
lines.en: I step back, my shell covered in sand
You stepped down and I burrowed
That buried me halfway
I shake and the sand falls off

lines.zh: 你别靠太近，我身上有刺
lines.en: Do not come too close, I have spines
Sand gives no footing
Touch again and I go under
Too few of my kind in the dead valley
A whole day's walk, not one
First the shell has to harden

lines.zh: 这片沙里，只有我的脚印
lines.en: Only my prints in this sand
Perhaps more will come with the rains
First I need somewhere to hide
Such things are hard in the dead valley

lines.zh: 我在这儿活下来就不容易
lines.en: Surviving here is hard enough
The wind takes even the scent
I scrape the sand away with my front legs
It is buried, one corner showing
I cannot drag it, only push

lines.zh: 这东西是硬的，还是热的
lines.en: It is hard, and warm
I flip it over to look
I do not recognize this
The sand covers it again
I carry it two steps
Keep it, it might be useful
You take it, I cannot lift it
A shadow is moving over the sand

lines.zh: 我把半截身子压进沙里。
lines.en: I press half my body down into the sand.

lines.zh: 死谷里风一停，声音就很清楚
lines.en: When the wind stops, sounds are clear
I shift toward the rock pillar
There is no grass to hide in here
I hear sand being stepped on
All six legs are crouched
It is blocking the sun
I am small, I can only hide first
The sand is soft, I can dig in
I press my body into the sand
The wind lifts the sand, good
I retreat into the pillar's shadow

lines.zh: 它的脚步声在沙上很闷
lines.en: Its steps are muffled on the sand
It is still on this sand
I am buried with only my eyes out
The dead valley's colors help me
Its shadow moves slowly
I wait for the wind to get up
When the wind blows, the sand will cover me
My shell is like the stones

lines.zh: 它要是再近，我就往岩柱后面去
lines.en: Closer and I go behind the pillar
The sand here runs deep
I will sink a little deeper
I sink a little at a time into the sand
It has stopped by the pillar
With the wind stopped, I must be even stiller
My shadow is already buried
I lower my head and butt
That push landed at your foot
My spines scraped you
Sand flew up and you blinked

lines.zh: 这点力气，我自己都嫌小
lines.en: Even I find this force small
I strike and burrow
Your feet are unsteady in the sand
That is enough to make you step back
Once I strike I burrow and run

lines.zh: 死谷的沙上多了个小影子
lines.en: A small shadow has appeared on the dead sand

lines.zh: 死谷的沙先动，然后是我。
lines.en: The dead valley's sand moves first, then me.

lines.zh: 风把沙子吹开，我露了出来
lines.en: The wind parts the sand and I am exposed
There is one more under the pillar
The sky is grey, which suits me
I spread six legs and settle

lines.zh: 这里没有别的东西在动
lines.en: Nothing else is moving here
I crawl past a bone
The sun is moving west, I came out
The fire made me dig for the sand

lines.zh: 我从岩柱上掉下来，壳磕了一下
lines.en: I fell off the pillar and struck my shell

lines.zh: 这里居然有水，我喘不上气
lines.en: There is water here after all, and I cannot breathe

lines.zh: 气浪把沙和我一起掀起来
lines.en: The blast threw sand and me together

lines.zh: 一支箭插在沙里，箭头擦过我
lines.en: An arrow stuck in the sand, the head grazed me

lines.zh: 一股凉意钻进壳里，很不舒服
lines.en: A chill went into my shell, unpleasant
Nothing to find in the dead valley

lines.zh: 雷打在岩柱上，我被震得发麻
lines.en: Lightning hit the pillar and numbed me
There is no sand to dig into here
